name: universaarl-bc-blueprint-v2
description: Nachweisbasierter, durch OpenSpec gesteuerter Implementierungsblueprint fuer Business Central

scripts.validate:archive-ready: npm run validate:openspec-schema && npm run validate:openspec && node scripts/validate-project.mjs --archive-ready
scripts.test: npm run validate:openspec-schema && npm run validate:openspec && npm run validate:snapshot-contract && npm run test:language && npm run test:german && npm run test:governance && npm run test:walkthrough && npm run validate:references
scripts.test:walkthrough: npm run check:media-toolchain && npm run setup:playwright:chromium && npm run build:walkthrough:baseline && node --test tests/artifacts/media-toolchain.test.mjs tests/artifacts/walkthrough.test.mjs && npm run test:walkthrough:html
scripts.pw:baseline: npm run setup:playwright:chromium && node scripts/run-playwright-local.mjs test tests/playwright/environment-baseline.spec.mjs
scripts.pw:baseline:headed: npm run setup:playwright:chromium && node scripts/run-playwright-local.mjs test tests/playwright/environment-baseline.spec.mjs --headed
